jobs.role: REDWOOD SOFTWARE | AI / JAVA CONSULTANT  | Remote
bullets: Architected and led delivery of Redwood RangerAI, an enterprise AI automation and orchestration platform from concept to production.
Designed AI architecture leveraging MCP, RAG, fine- tuning, and vector databases to enable secure, context-aware LLM-driven automation.
Built scalable retrieval and grounding pipelines using vector search to improve accuracy, reliability, and explainability of AI outputs.
Integrated LLMs into enterprise orchestration workflows, balancing performance, security, and operational robustness.
Led and mentored a team of 2 senior engineers, driving architectural decisions, code quality, and timely delivery.
Partnered with product and platform teams to align AI capabilities with real-world automation use cases and business goals.
Owned end-to-end design and delivery of core RPA platform features, driving architecture, development, testing, and production readiness.
Architected highly available, scalable, and resilient systems, applying proven design patterns and performance optimization techniques.
Led feature ownership and technical decision- making, ensuring long-term platform evolution and maintainability.
Enforced engineering excellence through code reviews, TDD, and high unit test coverage, improving code quality and reliability.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, enabling continuous integration and automated deployments.
Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for production support, resolving complex customer issues and improving system stability.
Delivered using Agile/Scrum methodologies, collaborating cross-functionally to accelerate product innovation. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
